scores.rationale: Repeated real-data table and price-duration plot runs stayed grounded; the final run added an exact fare locally at desktop and 390 px with no extra model turn.
The successful runs support exact budget, mode, directness and add-to-trip decisions, but one exact repeat ended empty and remains an unresolved reliability finding.
Repeated route-map and chronological-timeline scenes matched source fares; after the covered-scope race fix, Add remained local and error-free at desktop and 390 px.
The compact picker, alternatives, selected itinerary and total stayed synchronized with the chosen fare; post-fix desktop and mobile selection remained error-free.
Two independent runs reproduced exact per-mode counts and separate price and duration minima, plus a local add action and responsive evidence.
This compound case was planned but never run, so it earns no completeness or correctness points. Its useful leaves were tested in narrower cases, and the related sort interaction has a known defect.
The duration control and fare views rendered, but a repeat exposed the scoped-sort mismatch and ended with an empty refreshing picker.
Date, mode and carrier edits produced seven exact matching cards, and Add hydrated the tracker without another model request at both viewports.
Day selection, exact seven-day paging, return navigation and add-to-trip were verified against persisted state with desktop and mobile evidence.
The picker can select a fare, but SortSelect writes global sort while this dataset-bound picker reads leg sort, so duration ascending did not reorder rows.
FareCalendar rendered grounded date choices responsively, but the saved run lacks a complete named local interaction trace.
The accepted all-leg workspace represented route, stays and coverage correctly; interaction evidence is shallower than the single-leg decision cases.
The direct editor generated every leg control and live checks proved stay, mode, route and stale-fare behavior, though it is denser than the usual one-way task.
Two accepted scenes exercised tabs, carousel, split summary and local Add correctly, but the story-first workflow is less common than direct comparison.
The broad all-status prompt never produced an accepted terminal scene; narrower condition-specific cases provide the valid status evidence.
A genuine empty incomplete scope produced an honest coverage explanation without claiming real-world unavailability or offering an invalid retry.
ArtifactSkeleton rendered during four held refreshes, but remained after the requests completed because the authored status node is static.
A real local refresh failure preserved committed results; Retry issued two local requests, no chat request, and recovered successfully.
The preview correctly isolated a user-described old comparison from live fares, but automatic revision-driven stale behavior remains unverified after two timeouts.
